rubric_items.reason: No new route; authz, parameterised SQL via listWhere, enum validation, fixed-path links and logging all checked against head code; no real weakness missed.
Every claim and SF-1 cite the exact line at head (routes L12, repo L78/L95, service L40, page L22).
SF-1 as minor matches impact: the extra GROUP BY mirrors the existing full-table count(*) for unfiltered lists.
SF-1 gives direction (index or required filter if the table grows) but no concrete index or growth threshold.
No false positives; the single finding is real and proportionate.
